about: Minipress (prazosin), by brand name only, is supplied seven times from January to October 2026 to a 73-year-old man.
Prazosin (Minipress) is supplied four times from January to April 2026 to a 70-year-old man, in the middle of a 14-month history.
The only alpha blocker is tamsulosin (Flomaxtra), which this list entry does not name, so the criterion is not met.
